text: Every week, thousands of new companies are registered across the UK. In their first few weeks, many of them are looking for an accountant.
Getting in touch early makes a real difference.
NextGen Profit spots those moments for you.
Every day, we check official sources: Companies House, public notices, and the careers pages of local businesses.
When something happens, like a new registration, or a finance role that stays open for weeks, we record it, with the date and a link to the source.
Then we filter it for your area, rate how fresh and relevant it is, and add a suggested opening line.
Every Monday, you get a short, ready-to-use list for your region. Company data only. And every lead is delivered to you once.
Want to see what that looks like for your area? Request ten free sample leads. It takes one click.
NextGen Profit. The right companies, at the right moment.
